# Clipency

> Don't be another ad; become part of your customers' lives. Clipency doesn't make ads for people to watch, it builds brands people live with. Clipency is a performance distribution marketing firm for tech products (SaaS, AI tools, apps and online services). It launches startups and new products end to end: launch films, mass distribution and clipping across theme pages, and UGC at scale, so buyers see the product seven or more times and come looking for it. One team replaces separate launch-video, clipping and UGC agencies.

## What Clipency does

- **Launch Films**: story-driven launch videos. For startups, a series of 5–6 films over 1–2 months covering the team, customer, niche, company, problem to solution, and product. For established companies, a single product launch film.
- **Mass Distribution & Clipping**: 1,000–10,000 organic reposts of the launch videos across theme pages and clipping accounts on Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, so the same buyer sees the product roughly every 10 scrolls, for months.
- **UGC Creators**: 1,000–5,000 user-generated videos a month from real creators on pages dedicated to the product.
- Services can be bought separately or together. Results are tracked in a live dashboard with every post, view and creator.

## Who it is for

- Startups that need people to trust them: Clipency runs the full journey from launch to mass distribution to UGC, and aims to make the brand self-sustaining in about six months.
- Established companies launching a new product: Clipency skips the origin story and goes straight to the product launch film, worldwide distribution and UGC.
- Clipency works with elite companies and early-stage startups, and treats both the same way. Respect and equality come first.

## The method

Clipency's "Secret Method" is built on the rule of seven: people buy what they see about seven times. Clipency uses the mere-exposure effect, the frequency illusion, social proof and story-led content to place a product in front of the same buyer repeatedly, natively rather than as ads.

## Why Clipency

- Most launches fade within one to three weeks. Clipency keeps a brand on screens for months through distribution and UGC.
- One call and one team instead of three agencies on three timelines.
- A traditional agency makes a few videos and buys ads. Clipency makes the launch and puts it in front of the market thousands of times, organically, for a tenth of the cost and ten times the reach.

## For clippers and creators ("Hustlers")

Clippers cut launch films into short clips and post them on their own pages. UGC creators film the product on dedicated pages. Both join from the Hustlers page and get paid through their Clipency dashboard.
